caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a rug or tapestry centered on a cream-colored background. The central area features a dense arrangement of stylized floral motifs. These flowers are primarily in shades of yellow, cream, blue, and red, interspersed with dark green leaves. The flowers are grouped in a roughly oval shape in the center, with additional sprigs radiating outward. The outer edges of the rectangle are bordered by a continuous garland of smaller pink and peach flowers with green leaves, punctuated at the corners and midway along each short edge by larger clustered blossoms in cream and peach with touches of red. The background within the rectangular shape is a deep brown, which contrasts with the lighter, colorful flowers and leafy decorations. The entire composition is symmetrical, with the floral elements balanced on both sides of the central design.
title: Sewed "Caterpillar" Rug
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
